name: Kishanganj

queries.query: Kishanganj Bihar cadastral map land records official parcel map
queries.result: Found the official Kishanganj district land-records page, official Bihar Bhu-Naksha cadastral viewer, BiharBhumi, and Government of India DILRMP status page. First-party service ownership was established, but search itself returned no parcel geometry.
Found the Hindi Kishanganj district revenue/land-records page and official Bihar Bhu-Naksha. The search confirmed the same first-party custodians and returned no safe parcel geometry.

freshResearch.scope: Bounded anonymous first-party discovery; no login, credentials, private tokens, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or shifted point used.

sourceSummary.custodian: Directorate of Land Records & Survey, Government of Bihar / National Informatics Centre
sourceSummary.localEvidence: The official Kishanganj district land-records page directs users to Bihar land records. The Bhu-Naksha selector returned district Kishanganj (08), subdivision Kishanganj (01), and circle Kishanganj (01). This is local registry evidence, not a qualified city adapter.
sourceSummary.citySpecificQualification: Selector coverage was evidenced, but no city point-to-parcel response or full parcel geometry was obtained anonymously.

notes: No parcel sample retained: the bounded extent request returned HTTP 204 with an empty body. A zero exact-point hit, extent miss, or unusable response is not evidence of citywide absence. Serial review is required before admission.
